about_the_game:
[The game is still in early development, and most of the visuals are subject to change.]

Run your own space aquarium in this tiny, light management and creature collection game.

Collect strange aquatic creatures from outer space called gloops, and create ecosystems for them to thrive in. Take care of your visitors, coming in from every corner of the universe to admire your aquarium!

🚀 Explore the galaxy and uncover its secrets

Discover and explore new worlds, each revealing unique creatures. Bring back rare objects and materials to customize your aquarium, and capture new gloops with your remote fishing device. You may even get lucky and bring back shiny ones ✨

🐠 Study and take care of your gloops

Each creature has unique preferences. Place them in various tanks, experiment with their environment, and fill your encyclopedia with all there is to know about them!

🪸 Customize your aquarium

While looking for creatures, you may find new decorations and materials to customize your aquarium. Build new rooms, change the colors and place items to make it look just right!

👽 Welcome intergalactic visitors

Visitors from the whole galaxy will come to admire your creatures, so make sure that they get what they're paying for! Adjust the ticket price, and open your aquarium for the day!

✨ Meet your objectives

Each mission brings new creatures, new planets and more! Fill your encyclopedia, make money and drive visitor satisfaction up to unlock them all.

  • A campaign mode with 5 missions

  • 3 to 5 hours of gameplay

  • More than 90 creatures to collect!

  • Decorations and themes to customize your aquarium

  • A fun and relaxing journey through the universe

  • A trusty robo-cat, always ready to lend a paw-sitive hand! 😸

short_description: Build and manage your own space aquarium in this little management game. Explore the galaxy to catch strange aquatic creatures, and learn all about their needs to recreate their ecosystem. Customize your aquarium, welcome visitors from across the galaxy, and embark on a journey full of discoveries!
